problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Globally convex, continuously differentiable f: ℝ^d → ℝ with an attained global minimum; strong convexity is not assumed.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query returns the exact full Euclidean gradient, independently of history and seed.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same query also returns the exact function value; value and gradient constitute one oracle reply.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y, ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖₂ ≤ (L0 + L1 sup_{z∈[x,y]} ‖∇f(z)‖₂)‖x−y‖₂. L0,L1 are positive and public.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Some global minimizer satisfies ‖x0−xstar‖₁ ≤ R, whereas smoothness uses Euclidean norms. R>0 is public; queries and output are unrestricted points of ℝ^d.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with public positive integer d.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The exact global minimum value fstar is public, together with x0, d, L0, L1, R and ε. The objective and a minimizing point are hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point must satisfy f(output)−fstar ≤ ε, with public ε>0.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the execution law, within the supplied fixed oracle budget; algorithmic randomization is permitted.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines gradient-dependent Euclidean smoothness with an ℓ₁ distance bound to a global minimizer and public knowledge of the exact optimum value.
